   ```bash
   git checkout data-v1.0 -- data/raw/dataset.csv.dvc
   ```

   ```bash
   dvc checkout data/raw/dataset.csv

   ```

   ```bash
   dvc get . data/raw/dataset.csv --rev data-v1.0 -o <output_directory>/dataset.csv
   ```
